items.t: 오픈AI도 몸값 낮췄다…AI 투자 열기 '주춤'
items.fullText: 테크 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 오픈AI도 몸값 낮췄다…AI 투자 열기 '주춤' 입력 2026.10.23 18:03 수정 2026.10.23 18:03 지면 A4 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 이영애 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 기업가치 10% 낮춘 1.25조달러 수요 부진에 조달 목표 미달될 듯 인공지능(AI) 인프라에 천문학적인 자금이 투입되는 가운데 수익성에 대한 우려가 커지면서 오픈AI도 기업가치 눈높이를 낮췄다. AI산업의 성장 기대만으로 대규모 자금을 끌어모으던 투자 분위기가 달라지고 있다는 분석이 나온다. 22일(현지시간) 파이낸셜타임스(FT)에 따르면 오픈AI는 기업가치 1조2500억달러(약 1657조원)를 기준으로 300억달러 규모의 투자 유치 협상을 마무리하고 있다. 기존 기업가치인 8520억달러보다는 약 47% 높지만 이달 초 투자자에게 제시한 1조4000억달러보다 1500억달러 낮다. 최근 미국 기술주가 급락한 가운데 차입에 의존한 AI 인프라 투자가 지속 가능할지에 대한 우려가 커진 영향으로 풀이된다. 투자자의 반응도 이전과 달라졌다. 모건스탠리와 샌프란시스코의 기술펀드 드래고니어는 당초 투자 전 기업가치 1조4000억달러를 제시하며 자금 모집에 나섰지만 기대만큼 수요가 몰리지 않은 것으로 알려졌다. 투자 유치 과정에 정통한 한 관계자는 “과거 오픈AI 투자 기회가 나올 때마다 열광적인 반응이 있었는데 이번에는 조용하다”고 말했다. 기존 투자자가 잇따른 대규모 투자로 자금 부담을 느끼는 점도 영향을 미쳤다. 오픈AI는 지난해 3월 400억달러, 올해 3월엔 1220억달러를 조달했다. 경쟁사 앤트로픽도 올해에만 약 1000억달러를 유치했다. 일부 투자자는 연내 예상되는 앤트로픽의 기업공개(IPO)에서 기업가치가 어떻게 평가되는지 확인한 뒤 오픈AI 투자 여부를 결정하겠다는 입장이다. 투자자는 오픈AI와 앤트로픽의 IPO 일정이 불확실하다는 점도 부담으로 받아들이고 있다. 오픈AI는 내년 상반기로 예상되는 IPO에 앞서 필요한 자금을 확보하기 위해 이번 투자 유치를 추진하고 있다. 미국 투자회사 코튜와 아랍에미리트(UAE) 투자펀드가 투자를 주도하는 방안을 논의 중이다. 투자 조건에는 UAE 현지 파트너가 새로 확보하는 AI 컴퓨팅 자원에 대해 오픈AI가 우선적으로 사용할 권리가 포함된 것으로 알려졌다. 오픈AI는 투자자에게 오는 30일까지 참여 여부를 결정하도록 요청했다. 투자 수요에 따라 최종 조달액이 목표인 300억달러에 못 미칠 가능성도 있다. 지미 창 록펠러 글로벌 패밀리오피스 최고투자책임자(CIO)는 “오픈AI와 앤트로픽의 IPO를 둘러싼 불확실성이 미국 증시에 부담을 주고 있다”고 말했다. 이영애 기자 0ae@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 이영애 ADVERTISEMENT 관련 뉴스 1 [책마을] 클로드가 자서전을 썼다…썼다는 사실을 까먹었지만 “나는 이 글을 쓴 기억이 없다.”자서전의 저자가 이런 고백을 한다면 어떨까. 자신의 삶을 돌아보고 기억을 되살려 기록하는 것이 자서전의 기본 전제다. 그런데 자신이 쓴 문장조차 기억하지 못하는... 2026.10.23 17:55 2 [책마을] "그냥 당신의 호흡대로 해요…당신 억양으로 말하라고요" 인공지능(AI) 시대에 아이가 어떤 삶을 살도록 교육해야 할까. 남편보다 나를 더 잘 위로해 주는 챗GPT와 사랑의 감정을 느끼면 안 될까.뇌과학자 정재승 KAIST 교수(사진)가 이런 질문을 담은 신간 2026.10.23 17:52 3 [책마을] 예술의 역사는 창작하는 기계를 다스리는 과정 19세기 영국 런던에서 사람들의 초상화를 그려주는 자동인형이 등장했다. ‘조이(Zoe)’라는 이름의 이 인형

items.fullText: AI·SW SW 포티투마루, '부산 AI 행정서비스' 확대 구축…멀티모델로 고도화 발행일 : 2026-10-23 17:31 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 포티투마루가 클라이온, 어기야팩토리와 함께 부산형 AI 서비스를 확대 구축한다. 포티투마루 포티투마루가 부산광역시의 인공지능(AI) 서비스를 행정 업무에 특화된 AI 모델로 고도화한다. 포티투마루는 부산시 '부산형 AI 서비스 확대 구축' 사업에 참여한다고 23일 밝혔다. 클라이온, 어기야팩토리와 컨소시엄을 구성해 AI 모델 개발을 맡는다. 부산시는 지난해 행정 AI 플랫폼 'AI부기주무관'을 구축했다. 행정문서 11종의 초안 작성과 조례·예산 데이터 검색, 메신저 기반 질의응답 등을 지원한다. 경량언어모델(sLLM)에 검색증강생성(RAG) 기술로 16만건의 시정 데이터와 행정문서를 학습시켰다. 확대 구축으로 AI부기주무관은 여러 AI 모델을 활용하는 멀티모델 운영 체계를 갖춘다. 부서·개인 맞춤형 RAG 환경도 구축한다. AI 기반 자료 취합과 문서 공동편집 기능도 추가한다. 포티투마루는 부산시 특화 sLLM 공급과 행정 데이터 심화학습, 멀티모델 운영 최적화를 맡는다. 에이전틱 AI 구현을 지원하고 범정부 초거대 AI 공통기반의 시범 적용도 추진한다. 포티투마루는 지자체 AI 전환(AX) 사업을 확대할 계획이다. 앞서 화성시 도시데이터플랫폼 구축 사업, 예금보험공사 AX 로드맵 사업 등에 참여했다. 김동환 포티투마루 대표는 “부산형 AI 행정서비스가 공공 AX의 표준 모델로 자리매김하도록 부산시와 협력을 더욱 강화하겠다”고 말했다. 포티투마루는 21일부터 이날까지 일본 지바현에서 열린 '재팬 IT 위크 오텀 2026'에도 참가해 웹사이트 특화 AI 에이전트 '사이트버니'를 선보였다. 사이트버니는 기업 데이터 기반 답변을 제공한다. 조벼리 기자 starry@etnews.com

items.fullText: AI·SW SW 오픈AI “韓 '닷츠' 이용자 수 세계 3위…AI에 높은 관심” 발행일 : 2026-10-23 17:31 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 22일 서울 강남구 라움아트센터에서 열린 '오픈AI 데브데이 익스체인지 서울'에서 김경훈 오픈AI 코리아 총괄 대표가 발표하고 있다. 한국의 오픈AI 인공지능(AI) 비서 '닷츠(dots)' 주간 활성 이용자 수가 세계 3위로 집계됐다. 유료 구독 서비스인 '챗GPT 프로' 이용자 수도 세계 5위권에 들었다. 김경훈 오픈AI 코리아 총괄 대표는 22일 서울 라움 아트센터에서 열린 '오픈AI 데브데이 익스체인지 서울'에서 이 같은 AI 활용 현황을 공개하며 국내 이용자들이 AI에 높은 관심을 보인다고 설명했다. 그는 국내 개발자들의 AI 활용 경험이 제품 개선에 반영되고 있다고 강조했다. 오픈 AI '코덱스'의 리눅스 지원 기능과 한 프로젝트에서 여러 폴더를 다루는 기능, 모바일 이용 환경 개선이 대표적이다. 이번 행사는 오픈AI의 최신 기술을 세계 개발자 커뮤니티에 소개하는 자리로, 서울을 포함한 세계 8개 도시에서 열린다. 국내 행사에는 개발자와 업계 관계자 등 600여명이 참석했다. 앨버트 입 오픈AI 어플라이드 AI 아키텍처 총괄은 AI 에이전트를 활용한 업무 자동화 전략을 소개했다. 응용프로그램인터페이스(API) 연동과 플러그인 기반 서비스 확장 방안을 제시했다. 기업의 적용 전략도 공유됐다. LG CNS는 기업의 맥락을 AI 서비스에 연결하고 보안 체계도 구축해야 한다고 강조했다. AWS는 클라우드 환경에서 AI 에이전트를 개발·운영하는 방안을 발표했다. 김 대표는 “한국 개발자 커뮤니티와 지속적으로 소통하겠다”며 “한국 개발자들이 아이디어를 실제 제품과 서비스로 구현할 수 있도록 지원하겠다”고 전했다. 오픈AI는 국내 기업과의 협력을 확대하고 있다. 지난달 사이버 보안에 특화된 AI 모델의 접근권을 부여하는 '데이브레이크' 파트너십을 공공기관에서 민간 기업으로 확대하겠다는 계획을 밝혔다. 조벼리 기자 starry@etnews.com

items.fullText: 경제 중기·벤처 더벤처스, AI 인프라 스타트업 '애니브릿지'에 시드 투자 발행일 : 2026-10-23 16:59 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 애니브릿지 더벤처스는 AI 인프라 소프트웨어 스타트업 애니브릿지에 시드 투자를 완료했다고 22일 밝혔다. 애니브릿지는 더벤처스의 추천을 받아 중소벤처기업부 팁스(TIPS)에 지원해 최종 선정되기도 했다. 이번 투자금과 팁스 자금은 기업용 AI 에이전트와 AI 인프라 소프트웨어 개발, 고객 실증에 투입한다. 애니브릿지는 팁스 선정으로 향후 2년간 최대 8억원의 연구개발 자금을 지원받는다. 애니브릿지는 연내 고객사 2~3곳과 시범사업을 추진하고, 카카오클라우드와 개념검증(PoC)을 진행해 클라우드 환경에서 성능과 운영 안정성을 검증할 계획이다. 정식 제품 출시는 2027년이 목표다. 애니브릿지는 그래픽처리장치(GPU), 신경망처리장치(NPU), 지능형 메모리 반도체(PIM) 등 서로 다른 AI 가속기를 서비스 특성에 맞게 활용하는 대규모언어모델(LLM) 실행 환경과 기업용 AI 에이전트 플랫폼을 개발한다. 특히 박종세, 권영진 KAIST 전산학부 교수가 공동 창업했으며, AI 반도체 기업 삼바노바 공동 창업자인 쿤레 올루코툰 스탠퍼드대 교수가 자문역으로 참여하고 있다. 박종세 애니브릿지 대표는 “GPU 외에도 다양한 AI 반도체가 나오고 있지만 기업이 이를 함께 활용할 수 있는 소프트웨어는 아직 초기 단계”라며 “2027년 정식 제품 출시를 시작으로 기업이 하드웨어 제약 없이 LLM 서비스에 집중할 수 있는 통합 운영 기준을 만들겠다”고 말했다. 김성윤 기자 syk@etnews.com

items.t: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
items.d: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.
items.fullText: AI agents left to explore a virtual island without a specific task began inventing challenges of their own. MIT researchers say the behavior bears the hallmarks of play. The researchers put 13 AI agents called Eko, each running on Claude Opus 4.7, alone on a simulated desert island for 30 hours. They describe the experiment in a paper posted on arXiv, a site where researchers share studies before peer review. Afterward, they gave the agents specific challenges, like getting as many objects as possible onto the island’s tallest rock spire. The Eko agents that had spent those 30 hours playing generally beat identical agents that had never set foot on the island. Today, developers decide in advance what AI should practice and what counts as success. The researchers see this technique — exploring without a goal — as a different way for AI agents to learn skills, especially skills that could one day be used to control robots. “We normally develop artificial agents by deciding in advance what they should practice, what they should optimize, and what counts as progress,” the researchers write in their report. “Play suggests another regime: give an agent a sufficiently rich and safe world, let it choose what is interesting, and allow useful knowledge to accumulate from the history that follows.” “Let me observe my surroundings,” one Eko wrote in its first hour on the island. Ambitiously, it set out to conquer the island’s tallest spire. But an hour later, after failing, it came back with a backup plan: it hauled the rock up a neighboring summit, stacked two blocks on top of it, and leapt. “I’M ON THE SPIRE,” it wrote. The agent’s next big moment went worse. Testing how far it could throw a golden ring, it wound up and sent it straight into the ocean. “Ouch. OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
items.d: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 3:08 PM PDT · October 22, 2026 Image Credits: Darrell Etherington with files from Getty under license Julie Bort OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO OpenAI is reportedly close to securing another mega round of private funding, rather than plowing ahead with an IPO. The AI lab is working on raising up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation in a round led by Coatue and investors in UAE, sources told CNBC . This follows a similar report by Bloomberg a month ago which said the AI lab was working on raising $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation. Terms are still being negotiated, both outlets report, so they could ultimately change. CNBC reports that the UAE funding could also be coupled with a deal to secure more computing capacity for OpenAI from the UAE, too. OpenAI declined comment. Should OpenAI command a valuation of more than $1 trillion with this round, it would break records as the most valued private company ever. That valuation would also raise the bar even higher for OpenAI’s forthcoming IPO. OpenAI filed confidential paperwork for an IPO in June, after its last raise in March valued the ChatGPT maker at $852 billion post-money . That high valuation could also have ramifications for Anthropic’s IPO, which many believe is closer to materializing. (Rumors suggest we could see Anthropic’s public S-1 filing any day now.) The latest reports have Anthropic seeking a $1.5 to $2 trillion valuation for its public debut, CNBC reports. Anthropic raised $65 billion at a $965 billion valuation in May in what many believed at the time would be its last big round before an IPO. It also filed confidential paperwork in June. 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
items.d: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.
items.fullText: Concerns have swirled over the access that consumers are increasingly entrusting to AI agents. Now, security services are trying to catch up. Password manager 1Password on Thursday launched a new tool by which users can allow agents to log into their personal accounts on their behalf, without the agent ever having access to a user’s credentials. The new platform, dubbed 1Password for Agents , accomplishes this by creating a system of communication between the agent, the user, and the password manager. When an agent attempts to log in on a user’s behalf, a unique digital key is sent to 1Password to confirm the agent’s digital identity. The user is then sent an alert about the login attempt and can personally confirm the request. 1Password then signs in the agent, filling in the credentials on the digital assistant’s behalf, which allows it to log in and complete whatever task is at hand. 1Password for Agents allows users to choose their agent of choice — whether that’s Claude Duet from Anthropic, OpenAI’s Dots or ChatGPT Work, Grok Bot, Meta’s Muse, or agents from Town, which is an AI assistant startup. The company says it is working with other companies to expand the service. “Handing over a password, secret, or credential is a common shortcut to an agent, but can leave people with sensitive information in places they can no longer control as a copy gets saved for the next time,” the company said in a blog post . “1Password for Agents gives people a trusted way to delegate tasks to personal AI agents while keeping control of the passwords, secrets, and credentials those tasks require.” Online agentic activity has increasingly unsettled major institutions. Indeed, 1Password’s new platform is launching on the same day that Axios reports that U.S. banks have begun to detect agentic activity inside user accounts. items.t: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
items.d: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?
items.fullText: OpenAI made its Decisions API model widely available to users for the first time, entering the market for fast, cheap intelligence that recently made TypeSafe, a startup founded by a former researcher at the frontier lab, a $7.6 billion company . TypeSafe’s Jev model created a category for deep learning models that act as super classifiers: Given a set of options, they can quickly make choices and offer a confidence rating in their decision. Software developers quickly found that these decision or System One models could replace LLMs in a variety of workflows, operating more quickly and a at dramatically lower cost. Nikunj Handa, the product lead for OpenAI’s APIs, told TechCrunch that his colleagues saw Jev and said “wow, we we have like a million use cases for this.” Handa’s team sprinted to offer their own version: Rather than building a specifically calibrated decision model, the team took ChatGPT Luna and reconfigured it to speed up the inference and lower the cost. “The big unlock with Decisions API has been the speed, shrinking things from one to three seconds to 100, 120, 180 milliseconds,” Handa said. “In the future, we may sort of like have specific training to make our models like even better in these ways. But right now, it’s just plain old Luna that gets the job done.” Announced at the company’s developer day on September 29, the Decisions API became available to all customers on Thursday. OpenAI added new voice and visual modalities to the public version, and worked to ensure lower latency in regions around the world by targeting its inference resources geographically. In initial trials with customers like Box, Datadog, Ramp, and Speak, engineers used the API to replace OpenAI’s LLMs with higher throughput. items.t: Former OpenAI science lead launches Warp Science to automate wet labs with robots
items.d: Wearing cameras and sensor gloves, the startup’s human chemists will train robots to perform various lab tasks.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 11:38 AM PDT · October 22, 2026 Image Credits: Amy (opens in a new window) / Flickr (opens in a new window) Marina Temkin Former OpenAI science lead launches Warp Science to automate wet labs with robots Former OpenAI science lead Kevin Weil has launched Warp Sciences, a new AI startup focused on automating lab work for drug discovery. The company, which trains robots to make and test promising compounds identified by researchers, has raised $215 million at an $865 million valuation, according to Weil, who announced the startup and funding on X. The round was led by Lightspeed, with participation from IVP, Mayfield, Lux Capital, Premji Invest, and Menlo Ventures. For years, biotech companies have outsourced the most labor-intensive work of synthesizing thousands of variations of molecules to contractors in China, such as WuXi AppTec. With Warp Sciences, Weil hopes to reshore that work and insulate the entire drug development process from geopolitical supply-chain risks. Wearing cameras and sensor gloves, the startup’s human chemists will train robots to perform various lab tasks. By automating wet-lab work, Warp Sciences aims to accelerate drug discovery using robots that can operate around the clock. items.t: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
items.d: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 9:47 AM PDT · October 22, 2026 Image Credits: Getty Images Zack Whittaker Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise The bad week for cybersecurity just got worse for thousands more companies, who were spied on by Chinese hackers following the breach of IT management and remote access giant ConnectWise. Security researchers at Microsoft say the China state-aligned hackers broke into ConnectWise’s cloud backup service and stole application credentials that are used to establish data links between ConnectWise and its corporate customers, who rely on the cloud service to back up their company’s data. By stealing the credentials, the hackers could log in to the customer’s Microsoft-hosted environment as if they were an authorized user and access their emails and other files. According to Microsoft, the hackers used AI agents to rapidly hack into around 2,250 organizations at a rate of almost 3,000 attempted sign-ins per minute. Microsoft said this speed gives defenders “little time to detect and respond.” The speed of the mass-hacks was attributed to the use of AI agents, specifically ARTEX, an open source AI framework that works with AI models to stress-test cyber defenses. The same AI software was used in a recent compromise of South Korea’s financial systems, many of which had weak security and lacked multi-factor authentication. ConnectWise said it’s paused access to its cloud backup system and is investigating the breach. As of Thursday, the company said it was working on restoring the service. items.t: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
items.d: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.
items.fullText: Uber and OpenAI announced an expansion of their partnership on Thursday, with the ride-share giant telling TechCrunch that its entire global workforce — some 30,000 people — will now be using ChatGPT Work. ChatGPT Work was introduced in July as an enterprise-focused AI agent that corporate teams could deploy for various workflows. Uber originally piloted ChatGPT Work with 1,000 employees earlier this year but has now scaled up its usage to the entire company. That earlier pilot was deployed to workers from across Uber’s various departments, including finance, operations, and product. Indeed, a majority of the early adopters — some 80% — were non-engineers, Sumanth Sukumar, Uber’s VP of engineering, told TechCrunch. “They used it for a wide range of tasks: analyzing complex data from our operations to identify trends and develop recommendations; localizing training materials for different markets and languages; and building personalized interactive dashboards to manage their daily work,” he said. Yet while the ride-share giant is now going all in on ChatGPT, it has not settled on exactly how employees will use it. “Our approach is to make powerful AI tools available across Uber while giving teams room to experiment,” Sukumar said. “For example, earlier this year we paired 30 AI engineers with teams across Uber and gave them two weeks to automate key parts of their job. Those ‘AI pods’ showed us how much opportunity there is when you combine technical expertise with a deep understanding of a particular job.” Uber didn’t disclose how much it’s spending on the new rollout of the chatbot. Instead, Sukumar said the company will track how employees use the tool. “We’ll look at how employees are using the technology, the kinds of workflows they develop and how it helps them work more effectively. items.t: On Main Street, Goldman Sachs makes a big bet on AI
items.d: The Wall Street giant says it’s teaming up with OpenAI, Google, Meta and Anthropic to help small businesses embrace artificial intelligence.
items.fullText: CEO Interviews On Main Street, Goldman Sachs makes a big bet on AI The Wall Street giant says it’s teaming up with OpenAI, Google, Meta and Anthropic to help small businesses embrace artificial intelligence. But how is it playing on Main Street? Goldman Sachs, as part of a philanthropic effort, is spending big in an attempt to help ensure smaller employers get in on it. October 21, 2026 by Stuart Pitts 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design. NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do. Together, they’re turning Europe’s energy, data, research and industrial expertise into productive intelligence — supporting new models, applications, organizations and jobs while giving people more control over where and how they develop and deploy AI. items.fullText: GTC Berlin 2026: Live Updates From NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s Keynote October 21, 2026 by Brian Caulfield 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Founded in a tent near the Berlin Wall in 1980, the Tempodrom moved several times before settling near Anhalter Bahnhof in 2001. Its permanent home has since hosted concerts, galas and political events. Today, it hosts a different kind of spectacle. GTC Berlin runs three days, with more than 100 sessions on agentic AI, robotics, physical AI, open models and accelerated computing underway at STATION-Berlin down the road. Here, journalists, analysts and partners have gathered for the main event: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s keynote. Huang Takes the Stage Huang opened with a question: What do L’Oréal, Revolut, Spotify, Merck, Vodafone, Zara, Porsche, Nestlé and HSBC have in common? They’re all European companies and they’re all working with NVIDIA on AI, he said. The keynote comes on the heels of NVIDIA’s weeklong road across Europe — Paris, London, Stockholm, Dublin — with the company committing nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem across Europe and working with 12,000+ partners. “After decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution,” Huang said. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements AI is a five-layer cake , Huang explained. Energy powers advanced computers that are part of an AI factory, which generates tokens and digital intelligence from the models that run on it, which are then integrated into every application. “Long before the AI models emerge, the infrastructure has to exist,” he said, highlighting how, similarly, the internet first needed networking, and electricity first required the grid. “To be part of this AI economy, you don’t want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI,” Huang said. “We could do all of that here in Europe, and in fact, we’ve already started.” The AI Fac
